hooks.command:
python3 -c '
import json, sys, re
try:
    d = json.load(sys.stdin)
except Exception:
    sys.exit(0)
c = d.get("tool_input", {}).get("command", "")
if "git commit" in c and re.search(r"Co-Authored-By|Claude-Session:|Generated with.{0,3}Claude", c, re.I):
    sys.stderr.write("Commit blocked: the message contains an AI attribution trailer. Rewrite it without trailers (rules/no-coauthored-by-trailer.md).")
    sys.exit(2)
'
